name: ecro_material100_v1
authorization: User requests pre-RB-DTO-E ECRO training on near-mirror and SSS datasets and reference/prediction/error-map figures.
class: WL100 regular independent material-coverage training/evaluation; no RB-DTO mechanism or architecture adoption

model.unchanged: All learned layers, widths, positive factors, single flight, global application and output table. Replace/extend material BUFFER only. Separate fresh model per dataset.

objective: WL92A OWN: L_total + L_single + L_global, weights 1/1/1 and original target-patch-mean denominator; source-independent response supervision, no image fitting

near.material: Panel single isotropic GGX alpha=.01, F0=1, neutral coefficient .85; fixed .3/.8 checker on box A; other original ER/Lambert materials retained
near.scene: CK2 family; A centre perturbation +/-.035,+/-.07,+/-.04 m, yaw .08-.22; B out-of-view randomised; training/validation lights within a fixed front-panel region

sss.material: Sphere radius .4 m at (.9,0.4,0.4), homogeneous index-matched RTE sigma_t=12 /m, RGB scattering albedo (.92,0.80,0.65), isotropic phase. Actual in-medium random walk, including ballistic exit, not a diffuse BSDF or Burley substitute.
sss.other_materials: All room/panel and boxes Lambert to permit independent native-volpath validation; fixed .3/.8 checker box A
sss.encoding: Same 69-float material feature buffer; sphere row explicitly identifies fixed medium albedo and mean-free-path. This is a fixed-material dataset, no learned general medium compiler claim.
sss.ownership: One sphere entry-to-first-exit random walk is one optical-domain interaction including all internal collisions. Air remains explicit. Ballistic light connections through sphere included with Beer transmittance and one additional domain event. No overlap with learned higher-order lookup.

training.selection: final fixed step, no held-out tuning or restart after poor fidelity; one seed per dataset, no architecture-general conclusion

evaluation.metrics: linear HDR PSNR, relative RMSE/L1, ROI and full frame; separate higher order; independent reference-half noise, response fractions; common exposure and absolute error scales per dataset
evaluation.figures: reference | ECRO LOW+hl | absolute error | reference h | prediction hl | h error; full and material ROI, no denoise or independent image scaling

requirements: near GGX analytic check and visible checker
SSS source/first-exit physics checked against native Mitsuba homogeneous volpath on isolated sphere
material model buffer equals renderer table
preflight.sss_native_comparison: pooled sphere mean plus per-pixel error interpreted against independent MC noise; sigma_t=12 low-density boundary-offset qualification, not dense-medium validation
preflight.on_invalid_reference: fix execution/physics before freeze/main data, no training on invalid target

limits: First two optical-domain interactions and local material physics are physical, not learned. ECRO learns the >=3-camera-event remainder via its original boundary table. No claim it learns the entire local SSS response. Separate datasets; no new learned K/architecture, no rigid-reuse/economics or external neural-baseline superiority verdict. Historical results unchanged.
location: Local RTX 5080, existing external/8dna26/.venv-cu128; no server upload, no branch/worktree.
